Job Summary
PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a dedicated and skilled Maintenance Farm Broiler Talang Belido CPD to oversee, maintain, and repair all mechanical, electrical, and structural systems at our poultry broiler farming facility in Belido. This role is crucial in ensuring uninterrupted farm operations, maximizing biosecurity measures, and maintaining optimal environmental conditions for broiler health and productivity.

Job Responsibilities
* Perform routine preventive maintenance and calibration on farm machinery, climate control systems (cooling pads, ventilation fans), automatic feeding/drinking systems, and backup generators.
* Troubleshoot and repair electrical and mechanical failures promptly to minimize operational downtime and safeguard livestock welfare.
* Monitor utility consumption (water and electricity) and ensure the continuous, efficient operation of water filtration and waste management systems.
* Collaborate with the farm production team to prepare housing and equipment before the arrival of new day-old chicks (DOC).
* Maintain accurate logs of maintenance activities, equipment inventory, spare parts stock, and repair costs.
* Ensure all maintenance activities comply with company safety standards, environmental regulations, and strict biosecurity protocols.

Job Qualifications
* Minimum of a Vocational High School (SMK) diploma or Associate Degree (D3) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Proven experience as a maintenance technician, preferably in a modern closed-house broiler farm or agricultural facility.
* Strong knowledge of electrical installations, plumbing, generators, ventilation systems, and automated livestock equipment.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues quickly under minimal supervision.
* Strong physical stamina and willingness to work flexible hours, including on-call shifts for emergencies.
* Willingness to be located at the farm site in Belido and strictly adhere to biosecurity guidelines (such as showering before entry and staying on-site as required).

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
